# [TASK] Replace Alan AI voice control with self-hosted speech-to-text

## Task

Alan AI (the third-party voice SDK) stopped working — the hardcoded project key can't reach Alan's servers anymore (dead project on their side, confirmed via endless failed reconnects in console logs, not a bug in our code). Replace it with a self-hosted pipeline: browser mic -> local speech-to-text -> command handling, instead of a third-party SDK.

Chose self-hosted speech-to-text over the browser's built-in Speech Recognition API (faster to ship, but depends on Chrome/Google's servers) for $0 cost, no silently-dying third-party dependency, and a stronger showcase feature.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] ai-service exposes a working speech-to-text endpoint, reachable end-to-end via browser, gateway and ai-service (`SpeechToTextServiceTest`; the gateway carve-out is `GatewayIntegrationTest.speechToTextRouteIsPublic`)
- [x] Frontend captures mic audio and gets a transcription back, which flows into command dispatch (`VoiceControl.pipeline.test.jsx`)
- [x] All 4 voice commands work end-to-end: genre browsing, dark/light mode, logout, search (`VoiceControl.test.jsx`)
- [x] `@alan-ai/alan-sdk-web` removed from `package.json`, no remaining references anywhere in `frontend/lmdb` (`grep -rniw alan frontend/` returns nothing)
- [x] No cloud cost — runs entirely on the local stack (no test — architecture fact: `SpeechToTextService` loads Vosk models from local filesystem paths; no API-key property exists in `application.yml`)

## Estimate

**Hours:** 10

## Notes

- Approach: `SpeechToTextService` (ai-service) loads a Vosk model lazily per language; audio is resampled server-side to mono 16kHz PCM16; `VoiceControl.jsx` (frontend) captures mic audio and re-encodes it to WAV in-browser before upload.
- Command classification was rewritten in #214 (Story #200): `voiceCommands.js` now posts the transcript to `POST /api/v1/ai/voice-command` for LLM-based intent parsing, replacing the local keyword-matching this task originally shipped.
- Commits: `2932e21`, `9edcc0a`.
